questions.explanation_english: Under Rule 2(a), Appointing Authority includes the authority empowered to make appointments to the service of which the employee is a member, or to the grade currently held. It also includes the authority that actually appointed the employee to their present post, which can include appointment to a temporary post, making statement III incorrect.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। नियम 2(क) के तहत, नियुक्ति प्राधिकरण में वह प्राधिकरण शामिल है जिसे कर्मचारी की सेवा में नियुक्तियाँ करने का अधिकार प्राप्त है, या वर्तमान में धारण की गई श्रेणी में। इसमें वह प्राधिकरण भी शामिल है जिसने वास्तव में कर्मचारी को उनके वर्तमान पद पर नियुक्त किया, जिसमें अस्थायी पद पर नियुक्ति भी शामिल हो सकती है, जिससे कथन III गलत हो जाता है।
key_facts: Rule 2(a) defines Appointing Authority.
Includes authority for appointments to the service.
Covers authority that appointed the employee.
Printed answer key: (A) I and II only

questions.question_english: If a doubt arises as to whether the CCS (CCA) Rules apply to a particular person, who holds the final authority to decide the matter under the provisions of the Rules?
options_english: The President of India
The Union Public Service Commission
The Central Administrative Tribunal
The Secretary of the concerned Ministry
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is option (A) because under Rule 3 of the CCS (CCA) Rules, 1965, any doubt regarding the applicability of these rules to a person or class of persons must be referred to the President of India. The President's decision on such matters is final and binding on all administrative departments, ensuring clarity and uniformity in the application of the rules.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। CCS (CCA) नियम, 1965 के नियम 3 के तहत, किसी व्यक्ति या व्यक्तियों के वर्ग पर इन नियमों के लागू होने के संबंध में उत्पन्न होने वाले किसी भी संदेह को भारत के राष्ट्रपति के पास भेजा जाना चाहिए। ऐसे मामलों में राष्ट्रपति का निर्णय सभी प्रशासनिक विभागों पर अंतिम और बाध्यकारी होता है, जो नियमों के अनुप्रयोग में स्पष्टता और एकरूपता सुनिश्चित करता है।
key_facts: The President has the final authority on applicability questions.

questions.question_english:
An administrative authority communicates
displeasure to a teacher for habitual late
attendance by issuing a letter labelled “Warning”.
A copy of this letter is placed in the teacher’s
Annual Performance Assessment Report
(APAR) dossier. Does this “Warning” constitute
a penalty under the CCS (CCA) Rules?
options_english: No, a warning is not a recognized penalty under Rule 11.
Yes, placing any written communication in the APAR dossier converts it legally into a penalty.
Yes, because habitual late attendance constitutes misconduct requiring a formal penalty.
Yes, any administrative warning is automatically deemed to be a Censure once recorded in the dossier.
questions.explanation_english: An administrative warning is not listed as a penalty under Rule 11 of the CCS (CCA) Rules, 1965. Even if recorded in an employee’s Annual Performance Assessment Report dossier, issuing a warning remains an administrative measure rather than a statutory disciplinary punishment like censure or withholding increment.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। प्रशासनिक चेतावनी नियम 11 के तहत एक दंड के रूप में सूचीबद्ध नहीं है। भले ही इसे कर्मचारी की वार्षिक प्रदर्शन मूल्यांकन रिपोर्ट में दर्ज किया जाए, चेतावनी जारी करना एक प्रशासनिक उपाय है, न कि एक वैधानिक अनुशासनात्मक दंड।
key_facts: Rule 11 does not recognize warnings as penalties.
Warnings remain administrative measures, not statutory punishments.
Printed answer key: (A) No, a warning is not a recognized penalty under Rule 11.

questions.question_hindi:
नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं: एक को "असर्शन (A)" और दूसरे को "कारण (R)" के रूप में लेबल किया गया है। 
असर्शन (A): सरकारी सेवा से हटाए गए व्यक्ति को भविष्य में किसी अन्य सरकारी नौकरी के लिए आवेदन करने का कानूनी अधिकार है। 
कारण (R): सेवा से हटाना भविष्य में सरकारी रोजगार के लिए अयोग्यता के रूप में कार्य नहीं करता, जबकि बर्खास्तगी करता है।
options_hindi: A और R दोनों सत्य हैं और R A का सही स्पष्टीकरण है।
A और R दोनों सत्य हैं लेकिन R A का सही स्पष्टीकरण नहीं है।
A सत्य है लेकिन R असत्य है।
A असत्य है लेकिन R सत्य है।
questions.source: AI-generated from supplied reference material; CCS CCA Rules 1965

questions.question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R). 
Assertion (A): A person removed from government service is still legally eligible to apply for another government job in the future. 
Reason (R): Removal from service does not operate as a disqualification for future employment under the Government, unlike dismissal.
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is a. The key legal distinction between removal and dismissal lies in future employment eligibility. Removal from service terminates employment but does not operate as a legal disqualification for future government employment, whereas dismissal from service permanently debars the penalized individual from securing any future employment under the State.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। सेवा से हटाने और बर्खास्तगी के बीच मुख्य कानूनी भेद भविष्य के रोजगार की पात्रता में है। सेवा से हटाना रोजगार समाप्त करता है लेकिन भविष्य में सरकारी रोजगार के लिए कानूनी अयोग्यता के रूप में कार्य नहीं करता, जबकि बर्खास्तगी सेवा से स्थायी रूप से उस व्यक्ति को राज्य के तहत किसी भी भविष्य के रोजगार से वंचित कर देती है।
key_facts: Removal does not disqualify for future government employment.
Dismissal permanently bars future employment under the State.
Legal eligibility for future jobs remains intact after removal.
Printed answer key: (A) Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.

questions.question_hindi: क्या प्रारंभिक जांच (तथ्य-खोजी जांच) करने वाले अधिकारी को उसी मामले में नियमित विभागीय जांच के लिए जांच अधिकारी के रूप में नियुक्त किया जा सकता है?

नहीं, ऐसा करना प्राकृतिक न्याय का उल्लंघन करता है क्योंकि इससे पूर्व जांच से पूर्वाग्रह उत्पन्न होता है।
नहीं, सेवा नियम सख्ती से यह आवश्यक करते हैं कि केवल एक सेवानिवृत्त न्यायिक अधिकारी ही जांच अधिकारी के रूप में कार्य कर सकता है।

questions.question_english: Can the officer who conducted the preliminary investigation (fact-finding inquiry) be appointed as the Inquiry Officer for the regular departmental inquiry in the same case?
options_english: Yes, because having prior knowledge of the factual background ensures a more efficient inquiry.
Yes, provided the preliminary investigating officer holds a rank senior to the charged officer.
No, doing so violates natural justice by creating bias from prior investigation.
No, service rules strictly require that only a retired judicial officer can serve as Inquiry Officer.
questions.explanation_english: Appointing the officer who conducted the preliminary fact-finding investigation as the Inquiry Officer violates natural justice principles. Having formed prior opinions, the preliminary investigating officer carries inherent bias, rendering them legally ineligible to conduct an impartial regular departmental inquiry into the same charges against the employee.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। प्रारंभिक तथ्य-खोजी जांच करने वाले अधिकारी को जांच अधिकारी के रूप में नियुक्त करना प्राकृतिक न्याय के सिद्धांतों का उल्लंघन करता है। पूर्व विचारों के निर्माण के कारण, प्रारंभिक जांच अधिकारी में अंतर्निहित पूर्वाग्रह होता है, जिससे उन्हें उसी आरोपों के खिलाफ निष्पक्ष नियमित विभागीय जांच करने के लिए कानूनी रूप से अयोग्य बना दिया जाता है।
key_facts: Natural justice principles prohibit bias in inquiries.
An officer with prior involvement cannot be impartial.
Printed answer key: (C) No, doing so violates natural justice by creating bias from prior investigation.

questions.question_english:
A Principal in the Directorate of Education,
GNCTD, who draws pay in Level 12 of the Pay
Matrix, commits a severe breach of conduct.
For the purpose of identifying the competent
Appointing and Disciplinary Authority under
the CCS (CCA) Rules, the Principal’s post will
be classified under which group?
options_english: Group A
Group B
Group C
Super Time Scale Group
questions.explanation_english:
Under the classification rules revised post 7th
Pay Commission, civil posts carrying pay in Level
10 and above in the Pay Matrix are classified
as Group A posts. Since Level 12 falls within
this range, a Principal drawing pay in Level 12
belongs to Group A, determining the applicable
appointing and disciplinary authority.
questions.explanation_hindi:
सही उत्तर (a) है। 7वें वेतन आयोग के बाद संशोधित वर्गीकरण नियमों के अनुसार,

अधिकार रखते हैं, उन्हें समूह A के पदों के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया जाता है।
चूंकि स्तर 12 इस श्रेणी में आता है, इसलिए स्तर 12 में वेतन प्राप्त करने वाला
प्रधान समूह A का सदस्य है, जो लागू नियुक्ति और अनुशासनात्मक प्राधिकरण को निर्धारित करता है।
key_facts: Civil posts in Level 10 and above are classified as Group A.
Principal in Level 12 falls under Group A.
Printed answer key: (A) Group A

questions.question_english: What happens if an order of suspension is not reviewed before the expiry of 90 days from the effective date of suspension?
options_english: The suspension becomes invalid after 90 days.
The suspension period is automatically extended for another 90 days.
The disciplinary proceedings are automatically quashed.
The employee is deemed to have been terminated.
questions.explanation_english: According to Rule 10(7) of the CCS (CCA) Rules, 1965, if an order of suspension is not formally reviewed by the competent authority before the expiry of 90 days from its effective date, the suspension order becomes invalid upon the conclusion of the 90-day period, rendering continued suspension legally unsustainable.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। CCS (CCA) नियम, 1965 के नियम 10(7) के अनुसार, यदि निलंबन का आदेश प्रभावी तिथि से 90 दिनों के भीतर सक्षम प्राधिकरण द्वारा औपचारिक रूप से पुनरावलोकन नहीं किया जाता है, तो निलंबन आदेश 90-दिन की अवधि के समाप्त होने पर अमान्य हो जाता है, जिससे निरंतर निलंबन कानूनी रूप से अस्थायी हो जाता है।
key_facts: Rule 10(7) states that suspension becomes invalid after 90 days if not reviewed.
Printed answer key: (A) The suspension becomes invalid after 90 days.

इसे विभाग की सार्वजनिक वेबसाइट पर अपलोड किया जाना चाहिए और सूचना बोर्ड पर सूचित किया जाना चाहिए।

questions.question_english: How must a charge sheet under Rule 14 be delivered to the charged Government servant to ensure procedural validity?
options_english: It must be officially published in a leading local newspaper having wide circulation.
It must be read out verbally in person to the employee in the presence of two witnesses.
It must be uploaded on the department’s public website and notified on the bulletin board.
It must be served in person or sent by registered post with acknowledgment due.
questions.explanation_english: To satisfy statutory procedural validity and natural justice, a Rule 14 charge sheet must be officially served directly on the government servant in person against written acknowledgment or dispatched to their last known address by registered post with acknowledgment due, ensuring verifiable legal proof of delivery.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। नियम 14 के तहत चार्ज शीट को प्रक्रियात्मक वैधता और प्राकृतिक न्याय को संतुष्ट करने के लिए, इसे सरकारी कर्मचारी को व्यक्तिगत रूप से लिखित स्वीकृति के खिलाफ आधिकारिक रूप से सेवा की जानी चाहिए या उनके अंतिम ज्ञात पते पर पंजीकृत डाक द्वारा भेजा जाना चाहिए, जिससे वितरण का सत्यापित कानूनी प्रमाण सुनिश्चित होता है।
key_facts: A Rule 14 charge sheet must be served in person or by registered post.
Acknowledgment due is essential for legal proof of delivery.
Printed answer key: (D) It must be served in person or sent by registered post with acknowledgment due.

questions.question_english: If an employee is penalized with “withholding of promotion” for two years, and their turn for regular promotion comes up during this penalty period, what action must the Departmental Promotion Committee (DPC) take?
options_english: The DPC must promote the employee immediately on due date, as promotion is a fundamental right.

questions.explanation_english: When an employee undergoing the penalty of withholding of promotion comes up for promotion, the Departmental Promotion Committee assesses their suitability. If found fit, the officer is placed on the select panel, but the promotion order is given effect only after the currency of the penalty period expires.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। जब किसी कर्मचारी को पदोन्नति के लिए दंडित किया गया हो, तो विभागीय पदोन्नति समिति उनकी योग्यता का मूल्यांकन करती है। यदि उन्हें योग्य पाया जाता है, तो अधिकारी को चयन पैनल में रखा जाता है, लेकिन पदोन्नति का आदेश केवल दंड अवधि समाप्त होने के बाद प्रभावी होता है।
key_facts: DPC evaluates suitability for promotion during penalty period.

Printed answer key: (C) If found fit by the DPC, promotion is given

questions.question_english: Under the CCS (CCA) Rules, 1965, the penalty of 'Removal from service' fundamentally entails which of the following?
options_english: Termination of service with an absolute legal bar on any future employment under the Government.
Termination of service without barring future government employment.
Suspension from active government service for a mandatory minimum period of 10 years.
Forced submission of resignation without causing automatic forfeiture of past qualifying service.
questions.explanation_english: Removal from service under Rule 11(viii) of the CCS (CCA) Rules, 1965 terminates the employment of a government servant. Unlike dismissal, removal does not disqualify the person from future employment under the Government, leaving them legally eligible to apply for public service positions in the future.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। CCS (CCA) नियम, 1965 के नियम 11(viii) के तहत सेवा से हटाना सरकारी कर्मचारी की नौकरी को समाप्त करता है। बर्खास्तगी के विपरीत, हटाने से व्यक्ति को भविष्य में सरकारी रोजगार के लिए अयोग्य नहीं ठहराया जाता है, जिससे वे भविष्य में सार्वजनिक सेवा पदों के लिए आवेदन करने के लिए कानूनी रूप से योग्य रहते हैं।
key_facts: Rule 11(viii) of the CCS (CCA) Rules, 1965 defines removal from service.
Removal does not disqualify future government employment.
Printed answer key: (B) Termination of service without barring future government employment.

questions.question_english: Does the CCS (Conduct) Rules, 1964 apply to a person appointed on contract by the Central Government?

questions.question_english: A Principal issues a major penalty charge sheet under Rule 14 to a laboratory assistant. The charge sheet merely states, “You are charged with dereliction of duty on 12th May,” without attaching the statement of imputations, list of documents, or witnesses. Is this charge sheet procedurally valid?
options_english: Yes, procedural brevity is fully permissible if the alleged dereliction of duty is obvious from facts.
Yes, missing details and evidentiary lists can be validly provided later during the oral inquiry stage.
No, the charge sheet is invalid because it must be issued directly by the Directorate, not the Principal.
No, Rule 14 requires distinct charges, imputations, and lists of documents and witnesses.
questions.explanation_english: A charge sheet issued under Rule 14 must strictly contain distinct articles of charge, a detailed statement of imputations of misconduct, a list of documents relied upon, and a list of prosecution witnesses. Issuing a vague notice lacking these essential documents violates procedural requirements and renders the charge sheet invalid.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। नियम 14 के तहत जारी किया गया आरोप पत्र स्पष्ट रूप से अलग-अलग आरोपों, misconduct के आरोपों का विस्तृत विवरण, भरोसेमंद दस्तावेजों की सूची और अभियोजन गवाहों की सूची शामिल करना चाहिए। इन आवश्यक दस्तावेजों की कमी के साथ एक अस्पष्ट नोटिस जारी करना प्रक्रियागत आवश्यकताओं का उल्लंघन करता है और आरोप पत्र को अमान्य बना देता है।
key_facts: Rule 14 mandates distinct charges and supporting documents.
A vague charge sheet violates procedural requirements.
Printed answer key: (d) No, Rule 14 requires distinct charges, imputations, and lists of documents and witnesses.

key_facts: Rule 11 classifies penalties into minor and major categories.
Minor penalties include censure, withholding increments, and recovery of financial loss.
Compulsory retirement is a major penalty.

questions.question_english: A senior teacher is undergoing the penalty of withholding of promotion for three years. However, a junior teacher in the same seniority list is promoted during this period. The senior teacher files a grievance claiming his junior superseding him violates natural justice. How should the Directorate respond based on CCS (CCA) Rules?
options_english: The grievance is invalid, as promoting a junior is a direct outcome of the senior’s penalty.
The grievance is valid, because a junior employee can never be promoted while a senior is penalized.
The Directorate must promote the senior to the higher post but withhold the corresponding pay scale.

questions.explanation_english: When a senior employee is undergoing the penalty of withholding of promotion, they cannot be promoted during the penalty period. Eligible juniors can be promoted past them to fill available vacancies. Supersession resulting directly from an active penalty is legally valid and does not violate principles of natural justice.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। जब एक वरिष्ठ कर्मचारी पदोन्नति के रोकने के दंड का सामना कर रहा होता है, तो उसे दंड अवधि के दौरान पदोन्नत नहीं किया जा सकता। योग्य जूनियर्स को उपलब्ध रिक्तियों को भरने के लिए उन्हें पार कर पदोन्नत किया जा सकता है। सक्रिय दंड के परिणामस्वरूप होने वाली पदोन्नति वैध है और यह प्राकृतिक न्याय के सिद्धांतों का उल्लंघन नहीं करती।
key_facts: A senior employee under penalty cannot be promoted.
Juniors can be promoted to fill vacancies during the senior's penalty.
Printed answer key: (A) The grievance is invalid, as promoting a junior is a direct outcome of the senior’s penalty.
